Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live''

1. Scope — Specifies material, dimensions, constructional and other requirements of meat 
inspection table. 

2- Material — Frame shall be made of mild steel angles conforming to IS : 808 { Part 5 )-1976 
'Dimensions for hot-rolled steel sections: Part 5 equal leg angles { second revision )\ and/or 
medium grade galvanized iron pipe conforming to IS : 1239 ( Part 1 )-1979 'Mild steel tubes, 
tubular and other wrought steel fittings; Parti Mild steel tubes { fourth revision )\ The table 
top shall be made of 2 mm thick stainless steel sheet conforming to grade X04 Cr 1 9 Ni 9 of IS : 
1570 (Part5)-1985 'Schedule for wrought steels; Part 5 St^ainless and heat resisting steels 
( second revision )'. 

3. Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1,

4. Constructional Requirements 

4.1 The edges of the table sha!! be as shown in Fig, 1. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 The table top shall be smooth/ clean, duly polished and free from all defects. 

5.2 The frame shall be enamelled in white. 

6. Marking 

6.1 Each table shall be marked with the following information: 

a) Manufacturer's name or trade-mark, it any; 

b) Year of manufacture; and 

c) Batch or code number. 

6.2 Certification Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 
7* Sampling -~ As agreed to between the manufacturer and the purchaser. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Meat inspection tables are used in slaughter houses for the inspection and further processing 
of carcasses. 



Primed at Printograph, New Delhi, India
